Sandbox_AHG_TriggerRange_tooltip: Maximum distance at which the hotkey, radial menu, or context menu can operate a registered gate. Like a key fob: close range, not across the map.
Sandbox_AHG_CooldownSeconds_tooltip: Per-player delay between gate triggers. Prevents key spam from flickering gates. 0 disables the cooldown.
Sandbox_AHG_RequireVehicleGates_tooltip: When enabled, only multi-tile vehicle gates and garage doors can be registered as automatic gates. Disable to allow registering any door.
Sandbox_AHG_OperateFromVehicleOnly_toolt: When enabled, the hotkey and radial menu only work while seated in a vehicle (strict key-fob roleplay). The right-click option on the gate still works on foot.
Sandbox_AHG_BypassLocks_tooltip: When enabled, triggering a registered gate opens it even if it is locked or padlocked - the fob is the authorization. When disabled, locked gates refuse to open.
Sandbox_AHG_RelockOnClose_tooltip: When a locked gate was opened via lock bypass, restore its lock as soon as it closes again.
Sandbox_AHG_AutoCloseSeconds_tooltip: Automatically close registered gates this many seconds after they open - whether by hotkey/radial or by the vanilla E interact. 0 disables auto-close.
Sandbox_AHG_AutoCloseSafetyCheck_tooltip: Never auto-close a gate while a player, zombie, or vehicle is in the gateway. The close attempt is retried a few seconds later.
Sandbox_AHG_MinAccessLevelToRegister_too: The lowest staff access level allowed to register or unregister automatic gates.
Sandbox_AHG_MaxRegisteredGates_tooltip: Server-wide cap on the number of registered automatic gates. 0 means unlimited.
Sandbox_AHG_EnforcePermissionHook_toolti: When enabled, tagged gates require faction authorization using the Permission Provider below. Empty tags stay public. Admin/Moderator always bypass. Disable to let anyone operate all registered gates.
Sandbox_AHG_PermissionProvider_tooltip: Which faction system authorizes tagged gates when Enforce Permission Hook is on. Vanilla Faction Tag uses Project Zomboid MP factions. PLZ_Membership uses PLZ_Factions membership plus the USE_VEHICLE_GARAGE role permission (PLZ_Factions must be enabled). Gate tags still filter by faction name in both modes.
Sandbox_AHG_EnableHotkey_tooltip: Allow operating registered gates with the Operate Gate keybind.
Sandbox_AHG_EnableVehicleRadial_tooltip: Show an Operate Gate slice in the vehicle radial menu when a registered gate is in range.
Sandbox_AHG_EnableContextMenu_tooltip: Show an Open/Close Gate option when right-clicking a registered gate.
Sandbox_AHG_ShowHaloMessages_tooltip: Show halo text feedback above the player (gate opened, out of range, access denied, and so on).
Sandbox_AHG_DebugLogging_tooltip: Print verbose [AHG] diagnostic lines to the console/server log. Useful when reporting problems.
